title: Laundry Management System
tagline: A bold, ad-style laundry business website with real photography — that quietly reveals the Cyberussell concept behind it at the end.

liveProduct.text: This concept grew into a real product —
liveProduct.label: see the Laundry Management System live

overview: A self-initiated concept build with a twist: it's designed first as the official website of a fictional local business, "Aling Maria Laundry Shop" — booking, services, pricing, reviews — and only reveals near the bottom of the page that it's a Cyberussell portfolio piece, showcasing "LaundryFlow," the management system quietly running the business behind the scenes.
problem: Most laundry and dry-cleaning businesses run on paper logs or generic point-of-sale software that wasn't built for their workflow. And most "we build software" portfolio pieces look like software demos, not like something a real customer would actually want to visit and book from — which makes it harder for a prospective client to picture their own business looking this good.
solution: Built as a short, punchy sequence of bold flat-color poster panels — real duotone-treated photography, condensed grotesk headline type, icon-row value props, honest pricing, and a compact testimonial strip — closer to a mobile ad creative than a typical scrolling business site. The final panel is a deliberate reveal: a dark CTA that tells the visitor this was a Cyberussell concept all along, then invites laundry-business owners to request their own site.
results: A live concept demo that sells two things at once — a beautiful local-business website and the SaaS-grade system behind it — with a reveal moment designed to make the portfolio piece memorable rather than another generic case study.
